Description: Angron Attached Character is written two ways. Description: Tactical Support meltagun name is written two ways
Suggestion A: the numbers match Multi-melta. Summary table (page 8): Multi-Fuseur (20 cm / 1 / 3+ / −2), same as Breachers, Proteus, and Predator Infernus. Unit card and army list (pages 21, 24, 31): Fuseur with those same stats. These are two different Games Workshop weapons.
Note: Follow card and army list: Meltagun.
Chosen: Breachers stay Multi-melta in all three places.

Description: Deathstorm Autonomous Defense and Turret sit on opposite variants. Summary table (page 12): Assault Cannon Deathstorm has Tourelle on the guns and Défense Autonomes on the unit
Suggestion A: Missile Deathstorm has only Gabarit (12 cm) and is then removed. Special rules (page 6): missiles fire a 12 cm template and leave play

Note: Follow table and special rules: Autonomous Defense and Turret on the Assault Cannon Deathstorm.

Description: Whirlwind Castellan Reduces Cover is written two ways. Summary table (page 13): Vengeance missiles have only Artillery (100 cm / 1 / 4+ / −1)
Suggestion A: Castellan missiles have Réduit les Couverts (−1) and Artillery (100 cm / 1 / 4+ / 0). Unit card (page 50): either Vengeance or Castellan has Réduit les Couverts (−1), and Artillery is listed on the unit with Rapid Intervention.
Suggestion B: Follow table: Reduces Cover only on Castellan.
Note: Follow card: Reduces Cover on both salvos.
Chosen: Artillery stays on the weapons (shot rule). Rapid Intervention stays on the unit.

Description: Dire Wolf optional gun list disagrees with the titan weapons table. Summary table (page 15): choose 1 carapace among Canon Volcano / Laser à Neutron / Rayon de Conversion. Dire Wolf card (page 58): choose 1 carapace weapon, no list. Titan weapons (pages 17–18): Laser à Neutron is carapace for Dire Wolf
Suggestion A: Canon Volcano is an arm weapon for Reaver/Warbringer/Warlord only (not Dire Wolf)
Suggestion B: Rayon de Conversion is an arm weapon for Reaver/Warbringer/Warlord/Dire Wolf.
Note: Follow the unit table: those three as carapace options, including Volcano for Dire Wolf.
Chosen: Follow the titan weapons table: Neutron Laser carapace only
column10: C: Neutron Laser and Conversion Beam as carapace (drop Volcano).

Suggestion B: Keep Fiche in the profile and leave the missing sheet as a French 3.1.0 gap.

Description: Warbringer free Volcano / Quake Cannon slot differs. Unit card (page 59): buy 2 arm weapons and choose 1 carapace (Canon Volcano or Sismo-Canon), back-weapon cost already in the Titan. Suggestion A: Follow the card: free Volcano or Quake as the carapace / back gun, plus 2 paid arms.
Suggestion B: Follow the weapons table: those guns stay arm weapons (Warbringer would then have 3 arm slots).
